stage.act_iii.route.name: Madhuravani's account
story.act3.ending: ACT III · MADHURAVANI READS THE ACCOUNT
story.act3.ending_copy: Madhuravani joins a scheme against the proposed match; Gireesam's courtship remains unearned, and Buchchamma's future is not decided here. This is a compact Act III adaptation, not the full play.
stage.act_iv.route.name: A letter awaiting confirmation
story.act4.ending: ACT IV · THE LETTER IS NOT ITS SENDER
story.act4.ending_copy: Madhuravani's improvisation buys time; Agnihotravadhani has not independently confirmed the letter's claim. The wedding farce exposes status bargaining, while Buchchamma is not responsible for Gireesam's pressure or the marriage crisis. This is a compact Act IV adaptation, not the full play.
stage.act_v.route.name: Rumor is not a verdict
stage.act_vi.route.name: A wedding already moved
stage.act_vii.route.name: Street fraud and paper power
story.act5.ending_copy: The compact Act V episode ends without turning rumor into a verdict over anyone's past.
story.act6.ending_copy: The compact Act VI episode ends without reassigning Subbi's future or Madhuravani's door.
story.act7.ending_copy: The compact Act VII episode ends without trophies taken from the women in the case.
story.objective.act5.exit: ACT V · Leave without forcing a confession from rumor
story.objective.act6.exit: ACT VI · Leave contested claims unresolved
story.objective.act7.exit: ACT VII · Leave without claiming ownership of anyone's future
